name: io.github.ruizemanuel/ripio-community-mcp
title: Ripio (community, read-only)
description: Unofficial, read-only MCP server for your Ripio account: balances, activity, prices and limits.

environmentVariables.name: RIPIO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Ripio API key. Create a read-only key in Ripio > Profile > API.

environmentVariables.name: RIPIO_API_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: The secret shown once when you create the key.

environmentVariables.name: RIPIO_TRADE_RPS
environmentVariables.description: Ripio Trade requests per second: 1 by default, up to 3.5 with verified documents.
